Name: Read Project Billing
Description: Read a project's cards, subscription, invoices (incl. PDF) and checkout orders. Covers: GET /api/Billing/cards, /subscription, /invoices, /invoices/{id}, /invoices/{id}/pdf; POST /api/Checkout/quote; GET /api/Checkout/order, /active.

Name: Manage Project Billing
Description: Buy and change what a project pays for: open and pay checkout orders, add/set default/remove cards, remove or keep an environment at the period boundary, retry a past-due payment, unsubscribe. Covers: POST /api/Checkout/start, /pay; POST /api/Billing/cards/session, /cards/default, /cards/remove, /environments/remove, /environments/keep, /retry-payment, /unsubscribe. Owner-only in addition.

Name: Read Project Usage
Description: Read every quota meter of every environment of a project. Covers: GET /api/Usage.

Name: Sync Project Usage
Description: Create or update an environment's quota rows from the published catalogue. Covers: POST /api/Usage/sync.

Name: Read Plan Catalogue
Description: Read the published catalogue (environments, meters, limits, prices, top-up steps) and its history. Covers: GET /api/Catalogue, /api/Catalogue/history.

Name: Publish Plan Catalogue
Description: Publish a new catalogue and price book, or reload the active one. Changes what every project is sold and limited to. Covers: POST /api/Catalogue/publish, /api/Catalogue/reload.
